steps.label: Namespace
steps.sub: Groups related metrics: AWS/EC2, AWS/Lambda, or your own custom namespace

steps.label: Dimension
steps.sub: Name-value pair like InstanceId=i-0a1b2c — narrows to one specific series

steps.label: Resolution
steps.sub: Standard = 60s default; high-res as low as 1s, at a higher publishing cost

code:
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /ERROR/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 20
caption: fields picks columns, filter narrows events, sort/limit behave as expected.

code:
fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message "[*] *" as level, msg
| filter level = "ERROR"
| stats count() as errorCount by bin(5m)
caption: parse extracts structured fields from raw text; stats aggregates them by time bucket.

steps.label: Log stream
steps.sub: Events from one single source inside that group — one Lambda environment

steps.label: Retention
steps.sub: Set per log group; never expires until you set a policy
